What Connect Stripe does: it creates a new Stripe account for your business through Stripe's own sign-up page. If you already have a Stripe login you can sign in with it, and Stripe may offer to reuse your verified business details, but the new account is separate: the history of an account you already have does not move into it. Disconnecting stops Docustay using the account. Docustay never deletes it; it stays in your Stripe login.
